name: Adolfström-Sjnulttjie raststuga
estimatedTime: 7-8 hours (STF); Naturkartan 8-10 hours for Adolfström-Sjnulttjie raststuga
description: Adolfström to Sjnulttjie raststuga. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Public Naturkartan/STF/Länsstyrelsen-facing guidance still presents a 9 May-14 Aug stay-on-Kungsleden/leashed-dog/no-leaving-trail rule. Targeted legal/map follow-up found that 25 FS 2016:23 was valid only until 2019-08-14, the 2018 Natura 2000 plan also describes a temporary-through-2019 ban, NVR foreskriftsomraden returns empty, and national access-ban WFS has no Tjålmejaure feature.

Naturkartan links an overview map image for Tjålmejaure, but the Länsstyrelsen image returned 404 in targeted follow-up. No current official map found with marked rest-place/camping exception coordinates.
STF gives 7-8 hours; Naturkartan gives 8-10 hours for Adolfström-Sjnulttjie raststuga.
STF/Naturkartan/Bäverholmen/field sources agree on optional Adolfström-Bäverholmen boat but contact names/numbers and stale prices differ.

Official display is 23 km. WFS assembled endpoint-to-shelter is about 23.01 km; Naturkartan split plus spur/handoff is about 22.97 km; OSM relation plus spur is about 22.76 km. Adolfström has a 0.50-0.53 km handoff gap and Sjnulttjie requires a 0.33-0.34 km shelter spur.
Naturkartan says plenty of water along the broader route; field reports specifically warn that Sjnulttjie shelter itself lacks obvious nearby running water.
Route-app/general sources can imply free camping everywhere; public Tjålmejaure guidance and resolved legal/currentness caveat require more cautious language in protected-area context.
